'''Excavation rigs''' were used on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Raxus Prime/Legends|Raxus Prime]] by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] for excavation. During the [[Conquest of Raxus Prime]], some of the excavation rigs were damaged or overturned.
